title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
abstract: We introduce Adam an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions based on adaptive estimates of lower-order moments.

title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
authors: Nitish Srivastava;Geoffrey Hinton;Alex Krizhevsky;Ilya Sutskever;Ruslan Salakhutdinov
abstract: Dropout is a technique for addressing overfitting in deep neural networks by randomly dropping units during training.

title: Deep Learning Book
abstract: The Deep Learning textbook is a resource intended to help students and practitioners enter the field of machine learning in general and deep learning in particular.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks
authors: Ian J. Goodfellow;Jean Pouget-Abadie;Mehdi Mirza;Bing Xu;David Warde-Farley;Sherjil Ozair;Aaron Courville;Yoshua Bengio
abstract: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process in which we simultaneously train two models.

title: Deep Neural Networks for Acoustic Modeling in Speech Recognition
authors: Geoffrey Hinton;Li Deng;Dong Yu;George E. Dahl;Abdel-rahman Mohamed;Navdeep Jaitly;Andrew Senior;et al.
abstract: This article provides an overview of deep neural network acoustic models and their use in speech recognition.

title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
abstract: Training Deep Neural Networks is complicated by the fact that the distribution of each layer's inputs changes during training as the parameters of the previous layers change.

title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks
authors: Gao Huang;Zhuang Liu;Laurens van der Maaten;Kilian Q. Weinberger
abstract: Recent work has shown that convolutional networks can be substantially deeper and achieve better performance with shortcut connections.
